newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes lower on import covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes lower on import covering.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed lower against the dollar on Wednesday, weighed by commercial demand for the dollar, dealers said.
The rupee ended at 58.60 to the dollar, after opening at 58.52 and moving to 58.64.
"The rupee declined due to a number of import bills being covered," said a commercial bank dealer.
Dealers speculated that a couple of food and fuel bills were being covered in the market.
Overnight call money rates closed at 9.25 prcent, after opening at the same level and moving to 9.5 percent when a big state bank borrowed heavily, dealers said.
